subject: Pay now missing after partial payment

messages.name: Globex Corporation admin
messages.body: A client paid half an invoice in the portal and now there's no Pay now button for the rest.

messages.name: Maya (Support)
messages.body: That's BUG-2210-01 (High): the Pay now button is hidden for partially paid invoices on 2.2.1. It's fixed in 2.3.0. Meanwhile, open the invoice and use More > Copy payment link, then send that to the client.
